name: spoiler
title: Spoiler
description: Shows the start of long content, such as a description or a review, with a “Show more” button for the rest. The button appears only when the content is taller than `maxHeight`.

examples.name: basic
examples.title: Basic
examples.code:
import { Spoiler, Text, VStack } from '@advui/core'

export default function SpoilerBasic() {
  return (
    <Spoiler width="100%" maxWidth="96">
      <VStack gap="3">
        <Text size="sm">
          The north trail climbs through pine forest for the first two kilometres, then opens onto a
          ridge with views over both valleys. Most walkers stop at the stone shelter, where there is
          water from April to October.
        </Text>
        <Text size="sm">
          Past the shelter the path narrows and crosses two scree slopes. Keep to the cairns: the
          old path below them washed out in the spring and is closed. The summit is another forty
          minutes from the second slope.
        </Text>
        <Text size="sm">
          Come down the same way, or take the forest road from the shelter, which is longer but
          gentler on the knees and passes the lake.
        </Text>
      </VStack>
    </Spoiler>
  )
}

examples.name: labels
examples.title: Own labels and height
examples.code:
import { Spoiler, Text, VStack } from '@advui/core'

const changes = [
  'Faster search in large folders',
  'Dark theme for the settings page',
  'Export to CSV from any table',
  'Keyboard shortcuts for moving cards',
  'Shared links that expire',
  'Two-step sign-in with a security key',
  'Fewer emails about mentions',
  'A new icon for archived projects',
]

export default function SpoilerLabels() {
  return (
    <VStack gap="2" width="100%" maxWidth="96">
      <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
        What's new in 4.2
      </Text>
      <Spoiler
        maxHeight="24"
        showLabel={`Show all ${changes.length} changes`}
        hideLabel="Show fewer"
      >
        <VStack gap="1">
          {changes.map((change) => (
            <Text key={change} size="sm">
              {change}
            </Text>
          ))}
        </VStack>
      </Spoiler>
    </VStack>
  )
}
